Verſ. 10.
And the Lord ſpake againe vnto Ahaz, ſaying:

BEcauſe the Lord knew very well that King Ahaz was ſo wicked, as he would not reſt vpon his promiſe; he therefore ſent Iſaiah to confirme him by adding a ſigne. For when God ſees that his promiſes ſuffice vs not, hee addes fit and conuenient ſignes according to our weakeneſſe: to the end wee ſhould not onely heare him ſpeake; but that alſo in ſeeing his hand reached forth vnto vs, we might be further confirmed by euident teſtimonies. Whereupon we ought diligently to note the vſe of ſignes; namely, to what end God ſhewes miracles: to wit, that wee might bee confirmed by them in the certaintie of the word. For when we ſee his power, if we make ſcruple to beleeue his word, hee corrects our doubting, by making vs ſee euen the thing it ſelfe: and miracles being added to the word, doe become ſeales thereof.
